MAIN.calibration_note: Posterior means of independent per-number Beta-binomial models over the window. Not calibrated: the model ignores that the main numbers are drawn together, and no calibration has been tested.
MAIN.smoothing_note: Beta prior centred on the fair-draw rate, worth 52 fair draws.
